coverage.reason: Operator-only nonunique army indexes match the unchanged Store compiler. Real PostgreSQL fixtures reproduce the historical scan, verify owner/due index plans and bounded block reads, preserve realm/shard/status/projection filters, numeric and document-name ordering/cursors, and exercise concurrent exact-once launch debits and arrival status updates. Installer repeat and name-collision tests protect rollout. The shared store suite covers typed query/transaction semantics; the economy emulator covers unchanged server-authoritative concurrent economic rules. No client, gameplay, runtime, permissions, isolation or retry behavior changes, so browser visual testing and client build are not applicable.
Documents observed diagnostic evidence, scope, tested index definitions and explicit operator rollout/rollback. No additional runtime behavior or visual presentation is introduced.
